description:
Policy-only update to N-008 closing the adjudication gap exposed by ISS-011. ISS-011 proved VAL-CAP-006's declared-frame-count criterion cannot be honestly adjudicated on the M1 NVIDIA / KDE Plasma 6 / Wayland stack: DMA-BUF zero-copy hard-fails there, only SHM-fallback evidence exists, and there is no working zero-copy baseline on the host to measure declared frame count against.

Adds to N-008 (new §26, additive):
1. Disposition taxonomy: pass / fail / cannot-validate (no formal `blocked` — N-008 wording does not require it).
2. cannot-validate definition: complete evidence-backed precondition-unavailable; assertion neither passed nor failed; never green; never satisfies §24; parks the cell pending cross-platform validation.
3. Anti-abuse rule: cannot-validate eligibility is strictly narrower than fail; incomplete/ambiguous/unsupported predicate ⇒ fall back to normal pass/fail adjudication.
4. Platform predicate (all required): gpuInfo starts with "nvidia:"; Wayland+KDE evidence present; helper session log shows DMA-BUF negotiation failure + SHM fallback.
5. §24 guard: for manual rows, suite-level automated aggregation does not override row-level adjudication; skip-only or skip+pass suite summaries are not gate-green.
6. VAL-CAP-006 split: VAL-CAP-006a (minimised/occluded source survival, HUD continues, valid playable output — Issue #3 proof; existing §16/§17/§22 references resolve here) and VAL-CAP-006b (declared frame-count tolerance under zero-copy DMA-BUF; §6.1 ±1 frame unchanged).
7. ISS-011 evidence mapped by path (not moved/renamed) to VAL-CAP-006b.
8. On NVIDIA/KDE with the predicate complete, VAL-CAP-006b is cannot-validate (SHM only); AMD/Intel DMA-BUF must produce a real pass/fail (tracked by follow-up T-028).

Invariants: no runtime/source/capture/export changes; no ffmpeg argv, cadence, replay-semantics, helper-lifecycle, threshold/tolerance, verdictFromCounts, or runner status-union changes; no new typed runner verdict for cannot-validate; cannot-validate never becomes pass or skip; no skip-only result rendered gate-green; stop-on-first-red unchanged; §6.1 threshold text unchanged; T-023 untouched; ISS-011 stays inprogress. validation/rows.ts NOT touched (VAL-CAP-006 is a manual row with no runner driver, so the split lives in N-008 policy/§24 adjudication, not code).
title: Audit-safe validation-policy update: cannot-validate disposition + VAL-CAP-006a/006b split (N-008 §26)
